Eva Morales: Heads-up 7 RetailWorks is asking for a 3-week POC. Needs streaming product classifier (sub-200ms target), nightly embeddings for recommendations, and a tool call to their price service. They asked for a 10M tokens/month estimate and SOC2/KMS details.

Jon Park: Hosted ok per buyer, but they'd prefer Dedicated if latency tests land. Can we offer a temporary Dedicated trial?

Dev-Ops Nate: Yes, short-lived Dedicated (2x GPU) possible for trial. Need 48h lead time and signed trial terms. We support customer-managed KMS for data-at-rest and log encryption.

Aisha Khan: Pricing ballpark: for 10M mixed gen+embeddings expect ~$1.5k-$3k/month depending on model choices. I'll get a formal quote from finance.

Eva Morales: Security will send a questionnaire. Can someone prepare a brief Q&A on SOC2, retention, PII, IP allowlist?

sec-bot: Auto: SOC2 Type IIreport available after NDA. Default log retention 30 days (configurable). PII redaction hooks supported. IP allowlist and VPC peering available for Dedicated/Private. Docs: https://redwood.example.com/security

Jon Park: For integration, here's a tiny streaming + tool-call snippet (they want final JSON schema deterministic):

Jon Park: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key="<REDACTED>")
with c.stream('classify', model='redwood-gen-3') as s:
    s.send({"text": "Item: \"Heirloom Tomato 1lb\"", "schema": "catalog_v1", "tool_calls": ["price_lookup"]})
    for chunk in s.iter_chunks():
        print(chunk.text)
```

Aisha Khan: Example final payload we emit (single final JSON event):

Jon Park: ```json
{"product_id":"TMT-HEIR-01","category":"produce/tomatoes","confidence":0.94,"tags":["local"],"price":{"value":2.49,"currency":"USD","source":"price_lookup_v1"}}
```

Dev-Ops Nate: We can enable response schema validation and emit a diagnostics message if shape mismatches. I'll prep a runbook + terraform snippet for ephemeral creds and IP allowlist steps. ETA: Thu EOD. Need RetailWorks tech contact and IP ranges.

Eva Morales: RetailWorks requested a demo next Wed (stream -> tool-call -> S3 sink). I'll collect questionnaire answers and contacts. Aisha  can you confirm pricing by tomorrow 10am PT?

Aisha Khan: Yep, sending numbers by 10am PT.

Jon Park: I'll share a tiny sample repo and a 3-min demo clip.

Eva Morales: Great, keeping this thread as the single coordination source. :rocket:
